_about: Shravan's sound library. One entry per GarbhAudio id in lib/data/garbh_data.dart. `file` is what plays (streamed, then cached on the device); `sourceUrl` is the page it came from; `licence` and `attribution` are shown on the credits screen. Replacing a track is editing this file. Every entry below is a named recordist's own work released under a public-domain dedication (CC0 / CC PD / Public Domain Mark) on archive.org. `file` points at Cloudflare R2 (bucket parentveda-audio, prefix shravan/, 128 kbps re-encodes of the originals, uploaded 2026-09-13); `sourceUrl` stays on archive.org, where each recording and its licence live. The pub-*.r2.dev host is Cloudflare's development URL — a custom domain on the bucket is one host edit here and in narration_service.dart. The guided track (`bodyscan`) is not a file: it is a narrated script, see kKriyaBodyAwareness.
